newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Panasia to list subsidiary soon.
newsitem.headline: Panasia to list subsidiary soon.

text.p: Indonesian synthetic fibre and textile manufacturer PT Panasia Indosyntec said on Tuesday it planned to list a subsidiary soon, a company official said.
The company official, who asked not to be identified, said subisidiary PT Panasia Filamen Inti was planning to float shares on the exchange in 1997.
"But I cannot give you the details now as we are still discussing it," the official said adding that PT Trimegah Sekuritas was likely to be appointed as the underwriter.
According to the official, the subsidiary is a producer of polyester material for textile products.
Shares of Panasia Indosyntec were actively traded in the morning session following market talk of a possible rights issue, a stock split as well as listing of its subsidiary.
It was unchanged at 700 rupiah on 3.8 million shares volume after rising early to 725 rupiah.
The official denied rumours of a possible rights issue and stock split but said the company had held an analysts meeting last month where it announced plans to list its subsidiary.
